risk_title: Incident detection errors may delay or misdirect response
Unverified authorisation and override arrangements for automated protocols
Unreliable predictive analytics may misdirect public-safety planning or response
Incorrect event correlation may combine, duplicate or misclassify incident information
Public-safety information reused for CRM personalisation without adequately evidenced safeguards
Video and drone data may be captured or retained without sufficiently evidenced access and lifecycle controls
Security or integration weaknesses may compromise system integrity or availability
Backup, recording or recovery failures may interrupt public-safety operations or remove needed evidence
AI performance degradation may go undetected during operation
AI-related incidents and material changes may not be consistently investigated or controlled
External data-source quality or provenance may distort analysis if sources are used by Public Safety
